title: Non-atomic write in ChatStore::create loses new chat from changes
description: ChatStore::create runs INSERT OR IGNORE (which commits immediately), then if a row was inserted opens a second transaction to advance the state counter and write changed_at_counter. Between the INSERT commit and the counter update, the new chat row exists with changed_at_counter=0. A Chat/changes(sinceState) query arriving in that window uses 'WHERE changed_at_counter > since_counter'. If since_counter >= 0, the newly created chat (counter=0) is invisible to all since states, not just since_counter=0. Fix: move the INSERT inside the same transaction that advances the counter.
